text: My dental experience at Smile Center has been brilliant from the very first day I stepped into the clinic. 3 weeks back, I specifically flew down to Bangkok for my dental implant surgery because I trust all the doctors greatly and always feel comforted with their professionalism. Special thanks to Dr Kh Gun, Kh Mim and the rest of the lovely doctors for caring and taking care of me like family. I live in Singapore but choose to fly down to Bangkok to restore my dental health at Smile Center as they are the best in the business. I’m grateful to have found a gem of a place. My sincerest thank you once again 🙏

I came to the clinic with a problematic root canal issue that had been previously treated by another dentist,  here. Dr. Ruangwarin clearly explained the situation, took additional X-rays, and walked me through the treatment options step by step.

Two dentists I visited before refused to handle this complicated root canal, but she carefully located the problem and did real effort to save my tooth from the previous treatment. She spent a long time cleaning and repairing the canal with great precision.

I also really appreciated that I never felt any pressure to do additional expensive procedures when there was no real need for them. As a foreigner in Thailand, it is extremely valuable to find a doctor you can trust. Dr. Ruangwarin was transparent, fair, and professional throughout the entire process.

I’m very happy with the result and will definitely continue my treatment at this clinic.

The centre was great and the service was top notch. The entire team composed by the receptionists, assistants and dentists were extremely professional, patient and thoroughly explained all the options and alternatives available, procedures, durations and so on. I definitely suggest them for any dental work while being in Bangkok

First time in that branch (been to the other o e before)
The doctor was really nice and soft and gave me great advice for my cleaning.
Everyone speaks great English too!
I tried the painless technology for the cleaning and it’s great 👍🏽☺️

Very fast and efficient service from Dr Kalanyakorn. She is very gentle with her move and doesn't stress out the patient as usually we patients will be very nervous during dental treatment. And also the counter staff, Miss Fon and Miss Mim is very friendly and helpful. Definitely will come back for the next ddetal cleaning when I am back here in BKK.

The Smile Center is great! Dr Thapanee is world class for Invisalign! She is patient, thorough, explains well and provides the right guidance and advise! I highly recommend the smile center for anyone trying to do Invisalign ! They are the best
The staff here is incredibly friendly. The team is top notch and super talented. The quality of the work is great and the cost is very affordable. I would highly recommend coming here😊!
Lovely staff very professional and they all speak very good English. I felt very well looked after. I had 2 xrays, 2 teeth fillings and scaling and polishing and felt very comfortable!

Done one front tooth at smile centre dental clinic, staffs were friendly all can speak English. Especially Mim very helpful, reassuring, explain everything, cost , post implant. Dr. Gun is speaking English fluently, caring , so lovely . No pain during the procedure,  he showed the X-ray afterward, medications, temporary denture look natural . I love it

I had a good experience here with teeth cleaning. The lady was very professional and spoke good English like a native. She was very thorough with the water pik and the scraper. I was in the chair for about 40 mins and price was 1700 baht.
Apparently it depends how scaled up your teeth are.
They also accept cards with no issue.
Clean and polish- straightforward, no issues. No attempt to upsell more services despite easy opportunity. Very good service.

Amazing service. My friend and I came to the dentist in the midst of our holiday due to her immerse painful toothache. Realized she needed root canal and wisdom tooth extract. Did both treatment + cleaning during the first visit.  All for 17,000 baht. Would have cost 5x the price in Singapore.

Amazing service and great doctor. Very gentle and gave me advice on what to do with my teeth. I do not normally give reviews but this one deserves it. If you need a deep clean please go to this place. Amazing service and was able to get an appointment on the same day.. thank you..
I had my teeth cleaning done here. The service was fast and the work was done professionally.

I had a perfect teeth cleaning. They used Swiss latest generation technology : effective and painless, even on sensitive teeth.
The cleaning was done very well ! +++

The clinic is so clean and affordable. Its a 10/10

Everyone is friendly and everyone is smiling and can speak english

Fantastic experience. Came here for a second opinion after a previous dentist recommended extensive work. Following check up and x-ray, Smile Centre dentist gave me a very honest opinion stating that the teeth were in good condition and no additional work was required. Will be back.

It was our last day in Thailand and my husband wanted to get his teeth cleaned. We walked in and this place was able to get us in right away. Great service and the receptionist was very nice and helpful.

Our little boy knocked his two front teeth out on a water slide this morning. Smile Centre were kind and accomodating and able to fit him in to fix it almost immediately. Everyone spoke great English and were very caring. Plus he’s ended up with a million dollar smile! Throughly recommend!
The service is excellent here  The staff is knowledable and very efficient .  They are open every day and close to BTS   Their price is very competive.  I have been coming here for many years .
